availability.allowed_basis: CONTEMPORANEOUS_RECEIPT_PROVEN only for empirical signals; SYNTHETIC_TEST only for unit tests
availability.archive_rule: Last-Modified and current download receipt do not prove historical online receipt; never fabricate event+lag as measured availability. Archive-only source is outcome-only, cannot serve historical decision features
availability.empirical_source_gate: If all allowed sources lack contemporaneous receipt evidence, stop empirical replay, retain harness and report G2_R1_METHOD_OR_SOURCE_BLOCKED. Do not download prices just to discover an already known availability failure
availability.missing_derivatives: none required by registered spot candidates; Tactical benchmark ineligible; no forward fill
availability.strict_rule: event <= end <= receipt <= available <= decision < execution for every signal input

controls.FROZEN_TACTICAL: TACTICAL_POLICY_R2_B0 immutable diagnostic only; NOT_COMPUTABLE if required PIT derivative/universe inputs absent; never approximate or import protected baseline outcomes
controls.NAIVE_LONG: enter each available hourly slot with identical hold/stop/target/cost and single-position limit, four horizon controls
controls.NAIVE_MOMENTUM_LONG: last close > close24h earlier, same four horizon controls
controls.WAIT: all decision slots, zero exposure/cost/PnL; net_R undefined

costs.funding: zero by spot market identity; reject any derivative funding input; no funding income claim
costs.liquidity_stress: preceding minute notional participation <=0.0001; decisions fixed, no new candidates
costs.maker_not_filled: taker-only candidates have no maker dependency; optional maker scenario NEVER converts market fills into maker fills
costs.measured_liquidity: archive quote volume only; historical order book unavailable, spread/slippage are explicit scenarios, never measurement

data.raw_cache: unique /tmp/v06-g2-r1-<pid> only; never commit raw archives

diagnostics.grid: NOT_APPLICABLE; no grid registered; no paired-profit comparison
diagnostics.parameter_neighborhood: fixed ATR stop multipliers 1.35/1.65, diagnostic only and only if empirical source/support gate succeeds; never selection candidates

execution.collision: SL first; MFE on SL collision capped at entry or worse; no credit for unknown pre-stop high
execution.decision_ms: last hourly end exclusive + 60000; all feature receipt and available timestamps must be <= decision
execution.direction: LONG only, spot SHORT ineligible without measured borrow; no borrowing, leverage, martingale or grid
execution.entry_ms: decision_ms + 60000 at following 1m open; never same bar
execution.fill: all market taker fills conditional on entry notional <=0.001 * preceding complete minute quote volume; failure => NO_FILL; no invented maker profit
execution.margin: equals notional; return never multiplied by leverage
execution.missing: missing minute anywhere in requested trade path => NOT_COMPUTABLE entire observation, no filling/interpolation
execution.precision: Decimal 28 digits; canonical round-half-even 12 fractional digits in derived output
execution.purge: first 24h of each OOS partition embargoed; entry and full max horizon must fit strictly inside partition; one open position per candidate/symbol; no crossing or reused trade IDs
execution.risk: 1.5 * hourly ATR in quote price at decision; immutable through trade; entry risk fraction must be between 0.001 and 0.10
execution.stop: entry raw open - risk; gaps fill min(stop,minute open)
execution.target: entry raw open + 2*risk; target gaps receive target only
execution.timeout: final minute close after exactly registered holding hours

features.ATR: arithmetic mean of last 24 completed hourly true ranges using their preceding closes
features.BREAKOUT: last close > maximum highs of preceding 24 hours and last close > SMA24
features.RANGE_REVERSION: abs(last close / close 24h earlier - 1) <= 0.01; last close < SMA24 - ATR24; last close > last open
features.SMA: arithmetic mean of last 24 completed hourly closes
features.TREND_PULLBACK: last close > close 24h earlier; last low <= SMA24; last close > SMA24; last close > last open
features.calendar: UTC 60-minute bars assembled from exactly 60 authentic contiguous 1m rows, anchored on epoch hours
features.regime_diagnostic: UP/DOWN/RANGE from 24h return >+1%/<-1%/otherwise; never select subgroup

partitions.boundary_semantics: start inclusive, end exclusive; no retrospective window substitution

question: Do simple unleveraged long-only spot signals justify a separately authorized fresh independent experiment after realistic frictions?

ranking.eligibility: all source/PIT/cost integrity gates and support first; lower bootstrap bound > 0 and nonnegative higher_cost mean in at least 2 of 3 partitions
ranking.no_go: usable complete evidence/support but no eligible economic survivor
ranking.score: minimum(base mean net_R, higher_cost mean net_R) across pooled eligible trades; descending; candidate_id lexical tie break
ranking.unsupported: do not use a thin profitable subgroup or select best horizon after viewing outcomes

support.cluster: resample UTC 7-day blocks jointly across symbols; shared shocks not independent samples
support.coverage_min: 0.999 of expected authentic minutes for each symbol/partition, plus 100% per-trade and feature window
support.interval: percentile 95%, exploratory only; no iid standard errors
support.multiple_candidates: 12-way exploratory screening, no confirmatory p-values; no alpha claim
support.short: structurally zero/ineligible, not a balanced directional result
